_comment: Fixed lines the agent says on every call. These are rendered once by `pnpm --filter @msva/telephony render:prompts` and played from disk, so they cost nothing per call and add no synthesis latency. The `text` must match EXACTLY what the code speaks — if you change CALL_GREETING or a line below, re-run the render script or the line quietly falls back to live synthesis.

prompts.text: Namaste, main Madhusudan ki AI assistant hoon. Kaise madad kar sakti hoon?
prompts.usedFor: Spoken on every inbound call before the caller says anything.

prompts.text: Ek pal, main jaankari dekh rahi hoon.
Maaf kijiye, abhi call transfer nahi kar sakti. Kripya customer care se sampark kijiye.
prompts.usedFor: Honest fallback while provider-side human transfer is unavailable.

prompts.text: Maaf kijiye, aapki baat sun nahi paayi. Dobara kahiye.
prompts.usedFor: Recognition failure retry; never passed to the business agent as caller text.

prompts.text: Madhusudan family se baat karne ke liye dhanyavaad. Aapka din shubh ho.
prompts.usedFor: Sign-off at the end of a call.

prompts.text: Maaf kijiye, abhi seva uplabdh nahi hai. Kripya thodi der baad dobara call kijiye.
prompts.usedFor: Service-unavailable line without claiming an order, request, or ticket was saved.
